slides.title: Measure against *last month's you.*
slides.sub: Someone else's highlight reel was never a fair test.

slides.title: Notice who you're measuring
slides.body: When you feel behind, ask: behind whom? Often it's someone whose hard days you never see.

slides.title: Look back four weeks
slides.body: What did you handle a little better this month? A pause before a sharp reply. One honest sentence. Write it down.

slides.title: Count the small shifts
slides.body: Change rarely looks like a before-and-after photo. It looks like the same moment, handled a bit differently.

slides.title: One line, once a month
slides.body: Finish this: "A month ago I would have ___. Now I ___." Keep it. Read it next month.
